title: Low blood sugar
text: Suspect it with shakiness, sweating, confusion or aggression in anyone using glucose-lowering medicine.
If conscious and able to swallow, give 15 grams of fast sugar such as glucose tablets or juice, then re-check in 15 minutes.
If unconscious, seizing, or unable to swallow, give nothing by mouth; place in the recovery position and get the crew medical officer at once.
Follow any sugar with a longer-acting snack once recovered, and log the episode.

citations.source: ADA Standards of Care: hypoglycaemia treatment (15 g fast carbohydrate, 15-minute rule).
